title: Lupin Leads — Meta Lead Campaign
summary: A Facebook and Instagram lead campaign for contractors, with ad creative built for every trade.
overview: Lupin Leads sells qualified leads to contractors for a flat $100 a week. We built the paid campaign that finds those contractors on Facebook and Instagram: the offer, the audiences, the lead form and a family of ads that speaks to each trade in its own language.

cover.alt: Lupin Leads ad: a contractor in a cap looks up beside a house frame, with the headline Get more qualified leads for only $100 a week

challenge.heading: The challenge
body: Contractors are busy, sceptical and used to being sold leads that never pick up the phone. An ad has about a second to look like it was made for them, not for "small businesses" in general.
The offer also had to be impossible to misread: one price, one promise, no fine print.

idea.heading: The idea
body: Keep the message identical and change the person. Every ad carries the same headline — "Get more qualified leads for only $100/week" — in the same heavy type and Lupin green, while the image swaps to the trade we're targeting: a general contractor on site, a plumber under a sink, a framer driving a nail.
The purple-and-black grade and the rising arrow tie the set together, so the brand builds recognition even as the audiences change.

execution.heading: How the campaign runs
body: Strategy and offer: audiences set by trade and service area, with the offer front and centre in every ad.
Creative: square and vertical versions of each trade variation, made in-house, so new ads can go into testing within days rather than weeks.
Lead capture: Meta instant forms with qualifying questions, so contractors who aren't a fit filter themselves out before they reach the sales team.
Management: tracking from ad to lead, weekly optimisation of budgets and creative, and a plain-English monthly report on cost per lead and what we're changing next.
